_readme: The finalised cast, cloned from the repo's voice-reference/ folder.
`lang` is the character's NATIVE language — it selects the audition line and
groups the gallery. It does NOT limit what the voice can say: narrate.py detects
the language from the text, so every character speaks Tamil, Tanglish and English.
ref_text is the exact transcript of ref_audio, verified with mlx-whisper.

characters.name: Harper
characters.persona: polished American product narrator — clear, confident, explainer pace
characters.ref_text: This is the fastest and most accurate AI voice cloning technology available today.

characters.name: Imogen
characters.persona: British broadcast journalist — measured, authoritative, documentary calm
characters.ref_text: This is the research headquarters for one of the oldest companies in tech, IBM.
